page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance managed by the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity is provisioned at 64.0 GB, yielding a compute-centric allocation of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no integrated local storage, directing all file systems to network-attached storage solutions, and contains no hardware graphics processing units. Network connectivity provides a baseline throughput of 10 Gbps, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Hardware allocation prioritizes parallel CPU performance over memory density. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the server is architectured to maximize core density per unit of memory. While the absence of local disks necessitates external storage configurations, the 10 Gbps baseline interface delivers consistent networking throughput for data transfer and remote storage synchronization.

Workloads aligned with the instance profile include CPU-bound tasks such as distributed software builds, continuous integration and deployment workers, batch data processing, video transcoding, and compute-focused application serving layers.
